forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Two modules that import each other have no reading order, and no order in which a change to one can be understood before the other.

forbidden.name: view-reaches-the-api-through-auth
forbidden.comment: An application talks to the API through packages/auth, which is where the transport of ADR 0026 is hidden from it. A view holding the HTTP client would fork that choice per screen.

forbidden.name: generated-client-knows-no-session
forbidden.comment: What a generator rewrites at every install cannot sit downstream of code written by hand, so the dependency runs one way (specification section 4.6).
